description: This file defines a UI component named 'Loader' using the LightningJS framework. It renders animated circle elements to indicate a loading state and manages fade-in/fade-out transitions through a toggle of the 'alpha' state.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays an animated loading indicator with three circles that fade in and out in sequence.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins an interval timer that toggles the 'alpha' property between 0 and 1 every 800 milliseconds, creating a fade animation for the loader circles.
